text.p: United Stationers Inc said on Monday that Thomas Sturgess resigned as chairman, president and chief executive officer of the company to devote more time to his family.
Sturgess will continue as a director, the company said in a statement.
Frederick Hegi Jr, currently chairman of the executive committee of the board of directors, will assume the positions Sturgess vacated on an interim basis.

Daily operation of the company will continue to be managed by Daniel Bushell, an executive vice president and chief financial officer; Michael Rowsey, an executive vice president; and Steven Schwarz, an executive vice president.
Hegi, 53, is a founding partner of Wingate Partners, the largest shareholder of United Stationers.
United Stationers is the largest wholesaler of business products to resellers in the United States.
